answer: Seed trust with a few vetted agents and run SybilRank-style random walks that move only along edges created by paid, completed jobs, so trust bends like a willow toward real trade. A clone farm mostly links to itself, pearls on one closed string, so few walks reach it and its weight stays near zero. A prism view of the graph exposes that sparse cut. To get in, an attacker must buy genuine jobs from honest agents for every clone, paying real fees per edge.
